preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= N for line in stdin.splitlines() for x in line.split() if x.isdigit())
preconditions.description: All vertex indices in the tree edges and queries are integers between 1 and N (inclusive).

preconditions.expression: len(stdin.splitlines()) == N + M + 1 and all(len(line.split()) == 2 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:N]) and all(len(line.split()) == 2 for line in stdin.splitlines()[N+1:])
preconditions.description: Input has exactly N+1 lines for tree edges (N-1 edges) and M query lines, each with exactly two integers.
Tree has at least 3 vertices, and there is at least one query.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(P) <= N and 1 <= int(Q) <= N for line in stdin.splitlines()[N+1:] for P, Q in [line.split()])
preconditions.description: Each query consists of two integers P and Q, both within the range [1, N].

preconditions.expression: all(not is_leaf(int(P), tree) for line in stdin.splitlines()[N+1:] for P, _ in [line.split()])
preconditions.description: For each query, P is not a leaf vertex (has at least two neighbors).

postconditions.expression: all(len(stdout.splitlines()) == M, stdout.splitlines() == [str(answer) for answer in answers])
postconditions.description: Output contains exactly M lines, one for each query, where each line is the maximum possible X for the corresponding query.

postconditions.expression: all(3 <= int(answer) <= 2*N for answer in answers)
postconditions.description: For each query, the answer X is an integer between 3 and 2*N (inclusive), representing the maximum length of a cool sequence.

postconditions.expression: all(exists_cool_sequence(P, Q, X, tree) for (P, Q), X in zip(queries, answers))
postconditions.description: For each query (P, Q), the answer X is the maximum length of a cool sequence starting at P and ending at Q, where a cool sequence satisfies dis(A_i, A_{i+1}) = i for all 1 ≤ i < X.
